conviction_note: Q1 OP of 661m was already 37% of a full-year plan of 1,800m. The monthly sales put Q2 OP at roughly 250-500m, which takes H1 to about 50-64% of the OP plan and 70-80% of the ordinary-profit plan (1,300m), against 31-62% for this company at H1 in prior years. That makes an upward revision plausible, though not certain, so I lean modestly positive. The lean is capped for four reasons: management's caution (the November tax-free change, last year's halving of guidance), one analyst already at OP 2,300 / ordinary 1,850, no buyback room left in the cash plan, and J.Front falling 3% this morning after holding its own plan. p_up 58 on abs 5.0 gives +0.8; the findings sum to +0.9, and the two measurements agree.
bar: Company FY2027.02 plan: sales 44,000 / OP 1,800 / ordinary 1,300 / net 500 (million yen), reaffirmed in the Q1 tanshin 2026-07-14 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592340.pdf). There is no company H1 forecast. The market's own bar is ONE analyst (kabuyoho: OP 2,300, ordinary 1,850, net 877, TP 2,200, analyst count 1; https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8237 and https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=8237), so the bar is single-source and the findings that depend on it are capped. print_vs_bar compares my H1 OP estimate (~1,000m) with the H1 pace the company plan implies on this company's own H1 share history (38-50% of FY gives 685-900m): about +20%.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts are 0.82% (1 seller), up 0.12pt from 0.70% as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). The margin ratio is 0.37 (kabutan, 2026-10-14), so margin shorts exceed margin longs. irbank's weekly 信用残 to 07/17 shows margin shorts of about 384k shares against longs of 153k, which is persistent, about 0.75% of shares and roughly 1.5-2 days of volume, with 逆日歩 mostly 0.10 yen (https://irbank.net/8237/margin). The stock ran from 1,985 to 3,035 between 08-18 and 08-27 ('買い戻し優勢'), went limit-down on 08-31 and fell to 2,058 on 09-02 on the August 月次. It is now at 2,222, 20d run-up -2.2%, 5d +2.2%. There is no option skew in Japan. The positioning lean is mildly positive (+0.58) and agrees with the sign here, so a positive finding is partly in line with what is already priced.

findings.finding: H1 profit runs far ahead of the deliberately low FY plan. Q1 OP was 661m (+35.9%), 37% of the 1,800m plan, and Q1 ordinary 601m was 46% of 1,300m. Ginza main-store monthly sales of Jun 0.0%, Jul +1.1% and Aug -11.0% imply Q2 OP of roughly 250-500m (last year's Q2 was 518m). That puts H1 OP near 0.9-1.15bn and H1 ordinary near 70-80% of plan, against this company's H1 ordinary progress of 31% (FY24), 62% (FY25) and 41% (FY26). The plan implies H2 OP of only ~650-900m against last year's H2 of 1,631m. That sets up an upward revision at this print (the company revised at its H1 prints in 2023 and 2025), or at least a kabutan headline of a 進捗率 far above its own average.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance prints on actual dates: FY guide cut to OP 1,800 on 2026-04-14 gave -5.23% the next day. The H1 2025 halving of guidance, paired with a 4.5% buyback, on 2025-10-09 gave -0.39%. Q1 +35.9% OP with the plan held on 2026-07-14 gave +2.30%. All from Yahoo daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8237.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The company plan still reads OP 1,800 / ordinary 1,300 with PER 226x on company EPS of 9.9. If a revision were priced, the stock would have moved toward its August levels on revision hopes. Instead it sits at the single analyst's 2,200 target, after falling 32% from 3,035 on the August 月次 and the post-record-date unwind. The one analyst's 1,850 ordinary means a raise to about consensus is partly expected, which is why this is sized at +1.5 and not at the full history scale.
findings.independence: The monthly Q2 sales (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260910/140120260909533369.pdf) and kabuyoho's progress tracker, which shows ordinary progress of 46.2% at Q1 against 23.8% a year earlier (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=8237). Both use the same company numbers, so this is one fact. Peers: Mitsukoshi Isetan raised its FY guide at Q1 and reported positive September existing-store sales (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3099&b=n202610060323).

findings.finding: Q2 itself is weak on the monthly series. Ginza main store was Jun 0.0%, Jul +1.1% and Aug -11.0% (lapping last year's luxury-brand event and the Louis Vuitton reopening), and September was -1.9% with duty-free about -5%. Q2 OP is therefore likely below last year's 518m, and H1 OP roughly flat on last year's 1,005m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August 月次 already moved the stock: 2,276 to 2,058 (-9.6%) on 2026-09-02, and the September 速報 took it -1.9% on 2026-10-02. That reaction happened when the monthly data came out, not at the print.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced. The stock sold off -9.6% on the August 月次 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8237&b=n202609020299). What remains is only the margin read on Q2 OP, so the size is near zero.
findings.independence: The September 速報 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261001/140120261001544371.pdf) is a different document but the same series.

findings.finding: There is no room for a repeat buyback at this print. The updated plan's FY2025-27 cash allocation puts shareholder returns at 5.8bn yen, of which 4.6bn was used in FY2025 (the 2.3m-share, 4bn-yen buyback announced at last year's H1 print). The ~1.2bn left is about two years of the 12-yen DOE-2% dividend, and the 2026 dividend is guided flat at 12 yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2025-10-09 H1 print, a 4.5% buyback announced alongside a halving of guidance coincided with only -0.39% the next day. The buyback offset the cut, so its absence this time removes a cushion.
findings.why_not_priced: Retail holders may anchor on last year's H1 buyback. The cash-allocation slide is buried in a plan update, not in the 短信. Small, because nobody prices a buyback that was never signalled.
findings.independence: The FY2026.02 tanshin dividend section (12 yen, DOE policy; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260413502964.pdf) comes from the same company on the same day.

findings.finding: Peer read-through on the day: J.Front reported H1 on 10-13 at 15:30 with net -5.3% and FY progress in line with its 4-year average (no raise reported). It fell from 2,767 to 2,678 (-3.2%) this morning and Takashimaya fell 1.9%. Sell-side discussion of the department stores centres on the switch to the refund-type tax-free system from November 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No Matsuya-specific history for peer read-through. Its moves on peer prints are not separable in the data I have.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, because the entry is the 10-14 close and today's sector move sits in it. What remains is the reaction function: this tape punishes department stores that merely hold their plan, which lowers the payoff if Matsuya holds too.
findings.independence: SMBC Nikko's upgrade of Mitsukoshi Isetan cites the November tax-free change as an overdone concern (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3099&b=n202610060612). It points the other way on sentiment.

outside_window.finding: The September 2026 確報 (売上報告) is scheduled for 2026-10-15 16:00 JST, after the window's closing print. The switch to the refund-type tax-free system from November 2026 affects H2 duty-free sales.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible upward revision of OP 1,800 / ordinary 1,300. H1 is likely 50-64% / 70-80% of plan, against a single analyst at 2,300 / 1,850. Returns: a buyback is unlikely because the cash-allocation plan is nearly spent; the dividend is held at 12 yen. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: Q2 is weak on the monthly series, but H1 ordinary progress is far above the company's own 31-62% history at H1.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The baseline history's +8.07% on 2025-10-15 read as last year's H1 reaction
rejected_candidates.detail: The actual H1 release was 2025-10-09 15:30 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251009/140120251008570475.pdf), and the next-day move was -0.39%. The baseline's estimated date is wrong.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the mild positive positioning lean (+0.58: margin shorts exceed longs and short-squeeze potential) and cuts slightly against the flat 20d tape. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward revision toward the analyst's 2,300 OP, and I looked for it: Q1 progress plus the 月次 make it plausible. A buyback is the other possible positive, and the cash plan makes it unlikely. The strongest negative is a held plan with a weak Q2 in a tape that sold J.Front -3% for holding.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on 月次 the market already has): the Q2 monthly-weakness finding cut from -0.3 to -0.1, because the August 月次 already produced a -9.6% day.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): checked. The net sign is positive, and the strongest positive (a revision) and the buyback possibility were both looked for and recorded in baseline_tension. p_up left at 58.
Everything else left standing: the guidance finding, the capital-return finding, the peer read-through, abs_move_pct 5.0 and p_up 58.
